mainEntity.name: Do you offer medical weight loss?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. VN Healthy Living provides physician-supervised and goal-oriented programs designed for sustainable weight loss, including GLP-1 therapy. Call (619) 429-7700 to schedule a consultation with Dr. K.

mainEntity.name: What are GLP-1 medications and how do they help?

acceptedAnswer.text: GLP-1 medications like Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound help with weight management, blood sugar control, heart health, sleep apnea, and metabolic wellness. At VN Healthy Living Medical Group in Imperial Beach, Dr. K uses them safely and carefully for long-term health. Call (619) 429-7700 to schedule a consultation.

mainEntity.name: Do GLP-1 medications help older adults?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many seniors benefit from improved energy, mobility, heart protection, and better blood sugar control with GLP-1 therapy. At VN Healthy Living, Dr. K tailors dosing to be gentle and senior-friendly. Call (619) 429-7700.

Most patients tolerate GLP-1 medications well. Common side effects include nausea or constipation. Rare risks include slowed stomach emptying or vision changes. At VN Healthy Living, Dr. K monitors you closely throughout your treatment. Call (619) 429-7700.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be diabetic to use GLP-1 medications?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Many patients at VN Healthy Living use GLP-1 medications for weight management, sleep apnea, fatty liver disease, or heart protection — not only for diabetes. Call (619) 429-7700.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if GLP-1 therapy is right for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Schedule a consultation with Dr. Vijay Kuppurajan — Dr. K — at VN Healthy Living, 707 Palm Ave, Imperial Beach, CA 91932. We will review your health goals and medical history to determine the best plan. Call (619) 429-7700.

mainEntity.name: Has Dr. K received any awards from Sharp Community Medical Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Dr. Vijay Kuppurajan, MD — Dr. K — was awarded the Sharp Community Medical Group (SCMG) Award of Excellence as Top Coronado Primary Care Physician for Patient Experience Score, 2nd Quarter 2026. The award is based on independently validated patient surveys conducted by Press Ganey, the nation's leading patient experience measurement firm. The Coronado region cohort recognized by SCMG encompasses the City of Coronado (ZIP 92118), Naval Air Station North Island (ZIP 92135), and Naval Amphibious Base Coronado (ZIP 92155). Dr. K's practice is located at 707 Palm Ave, Imperial Beach, CA 91932 — immediately adjacent to the Coronado coastal corridor — and serves patients across both communities. The official Certificate of Achievement was signed by Sharp SCMG CEO Paul Durr and COO Christopher McGlone. Certificate image: https://vnhealthyliving.com/images/VNHL_DrK_SCMG-Award-Excellence_Q2-2026_TopCoronadoPCP_Certificate.png. Dr. K also received the Dr. Sam Hooper Compassionate Care Award 2022-2023 from CHRISTUS Health and Texas A&M School of Medicine. Call (619) 429-7700 or visit VNHealthyLiving.com.
